accepted_shares_total.status: Process-local counter; legacy canonical ledger count was persistent.

stratum_semantic_current_work_ratio.status: -1 before observation; one when no clients are authorized.

block_submit_seconds.status: Declared, rule deferred to A/#266; no production observations yet.

database_pool_acquire_seconds.status: Collector acquisitions only; ledger hot paths remain unwired.

database_advisory_lock_wait_seconds.status: Declared, rule deferred to #283 and A/C accounting-lock owners; no production observations yet.

pending_job_builds.status: Delivery count replaces the operational intent of queue depth, not its implementation.

runtime_lag_seconds.status: Runtime-stall intent replaces lease wake delay; no native writer lease.

blocks_total.status: Native confirmed-block process counter; not the legacy node-acceptance accounting boundary.

qbit_prism_public_requests_total.meaning: Every routed request, including /healthz and /metrics; never use in a request-rate rule.

qbit_prism_public_ledger_ready.meaning: Schema/read probe succeeded and remains within its freshness budget; zero before a probe, after failure, or when stale. Does not include the separate replica heartbeat refusal.

qbit_prism_public_ledger_probe_age_secon.meaning: Monotonic age of the last completed readiness probe (including failure); -1 before the first attempt.

qbit_prism_public_staleness_refusals_tot.meaning: Responses refused for exceeding an endpoint cache-age budget.

qbit_prism_public_replica_refusals_total.meaning: Database-reading routes refused by the public replica contract.

qbit_prism_public_degraded_responses_tot.meaning: Cached HIT responses served during database unavailability.

qbit_prism_public_database_outage_refusa.meaning: Uncached database reads refused during database unavailability.

qbit_prism_public_responses_total.meaning: HTTP responses by status, including health probes; appears after the first response.

qbit_prism_public_cache_total.meaning: Public route cache outcomes; appears after a public route request.

qbit_prism_public_replica_in_recovery.meaning: Last observed public read database recovery state; zero if never observed. Not the dedicated HA standby.

qbit_prism_public_replica_heartbeat_age_.meaning: Last observed public WAL-receiver heartbeat age plus monotonic time since observation; -1 if unknown/disconnected.

qbit_prism_public_replica_replay_lag_sec.meaning: Time since the last replayed transaction plus observation age; can increase on an idle primary and is not a byte-backlog or HA failover-loss measurement; -1 if unknown.

qbit_prism_public_replica_apply_backlog_.meaning: Last observed receive-LSN minus replay-LSN bytes; -1 if unknown; may remain cached after probe failure.

qbit_prism_public_replica_max_lag_second.meaning: Configured public read replica maximum lag/heartbeat-age budget in seconds.
